test_overview: Evaluated the regression test plan for the Furniture Delivery Calculator B2C pricing. Server was accessible at http://localhost:8000 with seeded data. Step 1: Opened root URL in a fresh browser; the Calculator is the default screen. Configured a B2C quote (Origin: Warehouse Central/Metroville; Destination City: Easton, Suburb: Riverside; item 3-Seater Sofa 1.20 m³ qty 1; Assembly 1; Rubbish 1; Rural 0). The Calculate Quote button enabled once required inputs existed; after clicking it the result panel showed the match tier badge 'Exact Match' and the Save Quote button was enabled — all step 1 verifications passed. Step 2: Clicked Save Quote; success message shown and a new saved quote was created (appeared in Quotes list). List card verified (non-fatal): B2C, route 'Metroville → Easton (Riverside)', Exact Match badge, total $178.00. Opened the detail view (/quotes/1) and verified: Exact Match badge; rate per m³ $115.00 (lowest among duplicate Exact Match routes 115 vs 120); volume charged 1.20 m³ (MAX(1.00,1.20)); Base Delivery $138.00; Assembly $25.00; Rubbish $15.00; Rural $0.00; Total $178.00; two-decimal formatting for currency ($178.00) and volume (1.20 m³). All verifications passed. Total score: 10/10.
